ns2:course.label: Senior Design Project Lab
ns2:course.description: Individual design projects in various areas of electrical and computer engineering; projects are chosen by students with approval of instructor. A professionally kept lab notebook, a written report, prepared to journal publication standards, and an oral presentation required. 4 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Senior class standing. Not intended for Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Additional Laboratory time to be arranged in 2070 ECEB.
